EducationSection.title:
Two attack vectors.

One goal.
EducationSection.description: Before you enter the Academy, you need to understand the rules of the game. Learn the hard foundations of quality engineering or collide your expectations with the brutal market reality.

vector1.label: Vector 01
vector1.title: QA Fundamentals
vector1.desc: Understand the anatomy of bugs, the tester mindset, and the tactics used by the best engineers. Build a solid base before you even touch automation.

vector2.label: Vector 02
vector2.title: Reality Check
vector2.desc: The junior market doesn't exist? AI will take your job? We reject the marketing bullshit of zero-to-hero courses and collide myths with hard IT realities.
